Application Data.NAME: Smith Financial Advisors
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith Financial Advisors provides comprehensive financial planning and investment advisory services, focusing on personalized wealth management strategies for individuals and businesses. Our operations include analyzing clients' financial situations, developing tailored investment portfolios, and offering ongoing financial guidance to help clients achieve their long-term financial goals. We maintain strict compliance with regulatory standards and prioritize data security through advanced cybersecurity measures, ensuring the protection of sensitive client information. Additionally, our team conducts regular audits to uphold the highest standards of service quality and operational integrity.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 12, 2022, a cybersecurity breach occurred, resulting in the unauthorized access of client data. The incident was immediately reported, and the firm engaged a cybersecurity firm to mitigate the breach and enhance data security measures. The total cost incurred for response and remediation efforts was $15,000. The situation was resolved, and no sensitive information was compromised. Current status: Closed.
